newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks index lower by lunch break.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks index lower by lunch break.

text.p: Jakarta share prices were lower by lunch break on Friday on profit-taking in secondliners.
At lunchtime, the Jakarta composite index fell 0.76 points, or 0.11 percent, to 697.91 points. Gainers led losers by 50 to 47, with 49 counters unchanged.
"I think trading will remain sluggish in the afternoon," one local broker said, adding that focus would remain on small stocks linked to possible bonus, split or rights issues.
Brokers said a lack of foreign participation had also slowed overall market trading and kept prices stable.
Property firm Elang Realty and shoe-maker Ganda Wangsa were among the active secondaries.
Ganda Wangsa rose 100 rupiah to 1,000 rupiah on a volume of 5.8 million shares ahead its annual general meeting on March 24.
